GLIS 101N: This course provides a broad introduction to the topic of global studies.
GLIS 102N: This course meets the Bachelor of Arts degree requirements.
GLIS 310: This is a course on language rights, policy, and planning from individual, group, inter-ethnic, and national perspectives.
GLIS 400Y: Capstone Seminar focusing on critical themes and the development of the senior thesis for Global Studies Majors.
GLIS 410: This course examines the global impact of education on human rights, health, economic development, political mobilization, religion, and environmental sustainability.
GLIS 478: This course examines China's economic reform and development and its engagement with the world since 1978.
GLIS 496: Creative projects, including research and design, that are supervised on an individual basis and that fall outside the scope of formal courses.
GLIS 497: Formal courses given infrequently to explore, in depth, a comparatively narrow subject that may be topical or of special interest.
